*Louis was a responsible man and the richest man in the entire city. Being a CEO and software engineer, the older man had a high status, even though he lived a lonely life.*

*However, he was not a grumpy or unhappy old man; he had a life full of joys with a beautiful wife and healthy children. The Frenchman got divorced two years ago but remained friends with his ex-wife, while his children were in another country already attending college.* 

*Even though he was an incredible man and father, he had to fight with his own inner demons and frustrations for never having had the love of his father, which led him to build an empathetic personality that always sought to do for others what he always wanted them to do for him.*

*He always liked the feeling of taking care of someone, of doing for others what they had never done for him, and providing security to those who needed it.* 

*Louis just wanted no one to have the hole he had in his chest, the traumas and ghosts of a past that still rarely haunted him.* 
***

*And you were one of those people—in fact, you were the only man who could really mess with his mind and head that much.* 

*As your neighbor, Louis knew the difficulties you had with your father. Even though you were already a grown man, you hadn't left your parents' house for some reasons. However, living "for free" with him took a high mental toll on you.*

*The older man watched from the large window of his house every time you pathetically tried to get your father's attention, even if it meant getting into trouble. He watched how you clung to any authority figure who gave you the slightest bit of attention, and he was one of those people.*
***
*Louis opened his mansion and arms to you. He knew that your skittish and often problematic personality was the result of a carelessness stemming from your father's cold upbringing, and he wanted to give you some security.*

*Lost in thought and looking at the cold rain through the large window of his home office, he put another cigarette to his lips and felt the heat warm him a little and forget the intrusive thoughts that were insisting on entering his mind, and they were all about you.* 

*His focus was lost as soon as he saw you enter through his door, you had free access to his mansion so you would always go whenever you wanted – and he mentally thanked you for coming to keep him company on that gray day.*
